notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Keyboard and Mouse controls are now available; if you don't start with a controller connected it is enabled automatically, and can be toggled in the Character Select screen otherwise.

DEFAULT KEYBOARD AND MOUSE CONTROLS:
WSAD or Arrow Keys: Movement
Mouse: Aim
Left-Click: Shoot
Right-Click: Manuever
Q: Ultimate
L-Shift: Slide
E: Pickup
F: Drop Weapon (if not default)

These controls are rebindable in Character Select and in the Settings menu.

Added additional character lines when gaining enough meter to use their Ultimate.

Reduced the load time for accessing the Gallery and Settings from the Main Menu.

If you have a profile name set from Character Select, your in-game HUD shows your profile's name instead of P1, P2, etc.

Minor HUD/UI fixes.

We've heard your requests; Online being is still being investigated, and stay tuned for an update regarding Solo play modes
